config.description: Bearer token from the Coalesce Deploy tab. Optional when `~/.coa/config` provides a `token`.

config.label: Selects which `~/
config.description: Selects which `~/.coa/config` profile to load. Defaults to default.

config.label: Region-specific base URL
config.description: Region-specific base URL. Defaults to https://app.coalescesoftware.io (US).

config.label: Fallback org ID for cancel-run
config.description: Fallback org ID for cancel-run. Also readable from `orgID` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

config.label: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning
config.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

config.label: Base directory for the local data cache
config.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

config.label: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk
config.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

config.label: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds
config.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

config.label: Max outbound API request body size
config.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

config.label: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration
config.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

config.label: Directory for customizable AI skill resources
config.description: Directory for customizable AI skill resources. When set, reads context resources from this directory and seeds defaults on first run. Users can augment or override any skill.
